data.title: KSrelief Continues Supplying Safe Drinking Water, Distributing Water Storage Containers in Yemen's Aden
data.content:
Aden, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) supplied safe drinking water and 454 water storage containers to displaced persons through 10 distribution points in Al-Buraiqa district, Aden governorate, Yemen, on Wednesday, benefiting 361 families. This is part of the emergency response project to provide drinking water to displaced persons in Aden.
    These humanitarian and relief projects, implemented by Saudi Arabia through KSrelief, aim to improve living conditions, provide safe drinking water, strengthen community resilience, and create favorable conditions for recovery in Yemen.
    -- SPA
22:08 Local Time 19:08 GMT
